heroHeadline: CDC and FDA Track Largest-Ever U.S. Cyclosporiasis Outbreak: 15,700+ Confirmed, 2 Dead
heroSubtitle: A multistate outbreak traced to Taylor Farms de México iceberg lettuce served at Taco Bell and sold under Walmart's Marketside brand has sickened over 24,000 people across 47 states since May 1, prompting a nationwide recall, congressional inquiry, and a separate CDC/Mexican-regulator dispute over the traceback findings.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
